headline: The page can no longer run away from your thumb
lede: Jon's iPhone report — Gauntlet scrolling like a document and the analog stick vanishing mid-drag — is fixed at the shared touch layer: pan, pinch-zoom, rubber-band and text-selection are pinned out of the arcade, and sticks now survive the viewport moving under a held push.

notes.text: Root cause: the 100vh shell outran Safari's small viewport, so the DOCUMENT was pannable — any drag off the pads scrolled the page and touch-cancelled the floating stick mid-push. html/body are now pinned shut (overflow hidden, overscroll-behavior none, touch-action manipulation) and every canvas is touch-action:none; the viewport meta pins zoom.

VirtualControls sticks (floating, fixed, diamond-gate, playfield swipe) remember their finger and re-derive direction + analog on resize/orientationchange/visualViewport moves — a push carries through a keyboard pop or rotation instead of dying.

touchselectcheck grew 16 to 62 gates and drives GAUNTLET with real touch events on iPhone-12 + iPad-Pro-11 profiles — including tapping NO THANKS on the first-run consent gate and a viewport resize WHILE the stick is pushed: arrows flow, scrollY stays 0, the knob never vanishes. Two hand-broken lines reddened exactly their gates and were restored.
Filed #2091 for the QA lane: gauntletplay's scripted starts hang on the auto-record consent gate wherever the research store is live (pre-existing, not this PR).
